Bug_Details:
This assertion will always fail or succeed. If a test subject and the argument to isEqualTo are the same instance (e.g.
assertThat(x).isEqualTo(x)), then the assertion will always pass. Truth
implements isEqualTo using [Objects#equal] , which tests its arguments for
reference equality and returns true without calling equals() if both arguments
are the same instance. To test the implementation of an equals method, use
Guava’s EqualsTester.
Bug_Explanation: The bug occurs when an object is compared to itself in an assertion. This always results in true, regardless of the implementation of the equals method.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by asserting that the object x is not equal to itself. This assertion will always fail because the showBug method is using reference equality, which will always return true for the same object.
